limitations: This is repository governance enforced against the trusted repository HEAD. It is not external attestation, remote-repository identity, or a public artifact contract.
Path and blob history checks are not an information-flow proof. They refuse governed Git deltas but do not claim to detect information copied from unrecorded channels.
This report creates no Quiet Bell oracle content, candidate, worker ledger, completion, selection, integration, compiler semantic, runtime, fixture, package, release, or Docker behavior.

Only exact prefix-240 candidate snapshots are grandfathered. Every later candidate must satisfy trusted authority, clean prehistory, exact declared delta, changed-blob, digest, report, scope, and linear-history checks.
